split.statement: The reported exposure coordinates were generated by the published PK simulation.
Do not multiply those exposure coordinates by fu again.

examples.avoid: Labeling the whole source REQUIREMENT/NOT_APPLICABLE hides the model-derived result. Do not invent a simulation method or parameters.

examples.source: This release performs no new fitting. An earlier validation fold failed. Revised project requirements need fresh review.

split.statement: This release performs no new fitting.
An earlier validation fold was reported to have failed.
Revised project requirements need fresh review.

examples.avoid: One RESULT label for release status, an analysis outcome and an instruction.

examples.source: Block A reports a single dose. Block B has no supplied cohort join. Block C contains an unresolved dose discrepancy.

split.statement: A cohort join was not supplied for Block B.
The dose discrepancy in Block C remains unresolved.

examples.avoid: Treating all three blocks as having unresolved metadata or interpreting a reported missing join as proof that no join exists.

examples.source: Compare AUC and Cmax only after dose histories are verified, unless the source limits comparison to one endpoint.
examples.keep_as_one: One REQUIREMENT/NOT_APPLICABLE proposition with its condition and exception intact; two endpoints do not force two items.

proposition_contract.limits: The host validates structure, exact evidence, references and review verdict consistency. It cannot prove proposition atomicity from keywords or component counts. Existing independent semantic reviews remain mandatory; no extra model call is introduced by this contract.

role_definitions.OBJECTIVE: The source's overall question or intended decision; not an achieved outcome.
role_definitions.FACT: A source-stated existing condition or background assertion; source reporting is not independent verification of truth.
role_definitions.RESULT: An outcome of a specified experiment or analysis, including negative and predicted results. Prefer RESULT over generic FACT for a particular analysis outcome.
role_definitions.HYPOTHESIS: A testable proposition proposed by the source. Keep the proposition separate from the result testing it; link using TESTS or SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS only when supported.
role_definitions.ASSUMPTION: A premise explicitly adopted by the project or explicitly attributed to a source analysis. Preserve who adopted it, purpose and conditions. Never invent an assumption from method familiarity.
role_definitions.METHOD: A procedure/model/analysis described by the source. Preserve planned versus performed in the statement and bindings; description is not permission to use it.
role_definitions.IMPLICATION: An interpretation or consequence argued by the source; preserve tentative, causal and conditional language without upgrading to observation.
role_definitions.REQUIREMENT: An explicit source obligation/prohibition. This is a discourse role, not a formally published project rule. Do not turn a prohibition on adopting X into a claim that X is false.
role_definitions.OTHER: Material content not captured by a more specific role; retain its meaning.
role_definitions.UNRESOLVED: The role cannot be confidently assigned. Preserve meaning/alternatives and distinguish label uncertainty from inability to understand the source.

evidence_status_definitions.OBSERVED: Source reports a directly measured/observed outcome; do not label a fitted parameter or prospective simulation as observed.
evidence_status_definitions.ESTIMATED: Source reports an estimate/fitted quantity from data. Preserve the method and data context.
evidence_status_definitions.PREDICTED: Source reports a model-based prediction for the stated setting, including human predictions without human observations. Link a simulation method via method_refs if explicitly described.
evidence_status_definitions.SOURCE_REPORTED: Source assertion whose production/evidence basis is not further specified; not verified truth.
evidence_status_definitions.ASSUMED: Explicitly adopted premise; not a measured result. Use with ASSUMPTION.
evidence_status_definitions.NOT_APPLICABLE: A production basis does not apply to this objective, instruction or method description.
evidence_status_definitions.NOT_FOUND: The relevant evidence status was not stated; this is not proof that experiments or evidence do not exist.
evidence_status_definitions.UNRESOLVED: The source evidence status is ambiguous; preserve the ambiguity.

instructions: Apply CC009 using the definitions below in the existing inventory call. Each item has one science object; inventory kind FACT/UNKNOWN is a separate retention label, not scientific truth.

Apply proposition_contract: establish assertion boundaries before assigning one science object to each item. Read the full supplied passage, including headings, table headers and footnotes; keywords are not a classifier or completeness whitelist.
method_refs point to METHOD items. adoption_relations and relations point to supported inventory items with component evidence. Describe a source analysis separately from project adoption.

Only explicitly stated/adopted premises may be ASSUMPTION. Model-inferred possibilities stay in potential_questions with MODEL_INFERENCE, PENDING_CONFIRMATION, rationale, source_refs, needed_at and impact; do not manufacture questions.
Use binding_contract below for every binding. Apply CC005 and its terminology appendix to relevant attributes; a shared word or species alone never establishes a join.

Use the response schema's existing fields. CC011 owns evidence placement; CC008 owns compact output; CC012 owns inventory/final review coverage and unchanged publication. PRESERVED means faithful representation, not scientifically verified truth.

The inventory is private audit material. Main.json receives compact statements, scientific role/status, meaningful relationships and pending questions, without bindings, original-source links, quotes or character offsets. Each statement must carry all decision-relevant meaning itself: never put a critical quantity, unit, scope, condition, negation, exception or association only in bindings. Keep functional data-file and formal-rule references. Final reviewers check the exact compact projection before release.

binding_contract.value_definition: Copy one nonempty, continuous, verbatim excerpt of the cited source of a component selected by component_ids. The excerpt may come from an evidence[].quote, from the rest of that quote's line or source unit (for example a label or heading such as 'Mouse:'), or, for a spreadsheet row, from another cell of the same row, the sheet name or a column header above the cited cell. Prefer the quote when it contains the value. Preserve spelling, case, punctuation, numbers and units. Do not summarize, normalize, translate, add labels or join excerpts in value; put faithful compressed meaning in the item's statement.
binding_contract.component_definition: Select existing component IDs from this same item. At least one selected component must contain the complete value in its cited source: a verified quote, that quote's line or source unit, or its spreadsheet row, sheet name or column header. Other selected components may supply linked context or conditions; never borrow an unrelated item's or study's evidence.
actions: Select a task-relevant field, locate its source component, and copy the exact excerpt before drafting the compact statement. Do not fill every possible field.

Use one binding per independently located value. Repeating a field is allowed for distinct values, but keep their analysis-specific relationships explicit; split independent propositions into separate items when needed.

Keep necessary qualifiers, negation, conditions and exceptions in components and statement; use separate exact condition/negation/exception bindings when useful. Do not remove constraints just to make a shorter value match.
If no exact source value exists, do not invent a binding or use NOT_FOUND as a fabricated quote. Preserve the unresolved information in the appropriate unknown or pending-question record.

Self-check every value against the cited source of a selected component and every quote against its supplied source unit; the value must describe the same record as the quote. Passing exact-text checks does not establish correct field classification, scientific pairing or semantic completeness; independent reviews still check these.

pk_binding_knowledge.use: Read source propositions using this English reference. Terms in a family are related, not interchangeable. Only aliases explicitly map alternative names. Source definitions override conventional symbols; preserve unfamiliar terms too. This is neither a completeness whitelist nor evidence of project facts, selected methods or obligations.
pk_binding_knowledge.organization: Dose input -> exposure -> disposition -> exposure basis -> modeling. Consult evaluation, translation and PK/PD extensions when relevant; their presence does not require those analyses.

concepts.name: Dose amount
concepts.check: Retain amount, units, formulation and absolute versus body-weight-normalized basis; one administration is not one day.

concepts.name: Dosing schedule
concepts.check: Keep route and schedule with the dose; do not infer either from a concentration curve.

concepts.name: Administration input
concepts.check: Bolus and infusion have different inputs; retain rate and duration separately. Preserve any named extravascular route.

concepts.name: Absorption rate and delay
concepts.check: ka is an absorption rate constant; lag and transit times are distinct delay representations, not elimination half-lives.

concepts.name: Extent of systemic availability
concepts.check: Confirm the source definition and reference route/formulation; do not assign an absolute F from a relative comparison.

concepts.name: Concentration summaries
concepts.check: Retain sampled versus model-derived values and the time window. Cmin is the interval minimum; Ctrough is tied to predose timing. C0 may be extrapolated.

concepts.name: Concentration-time integral
concepts.check: Preserve integration limits, time units, sampling origin and first-dose versus steady-state status. Extrapolated and observed-window exposure differ.

concepts.name: Time-weighted exposure and residence
concepts.check: AUMC is the first moment of the concentration-time curve; MRT is mean residence time. Preserve route, integration window and input-duration correction; MRT is not MTT or half-life.

concepts.name: Repeated-dose exposure
concepts.check: Specify which metric is ratioed and its reference dose/window; a simulated steady-state profile is not an observed one.

concepts.name: Dose-exposure relationship
concepts.check: Retain the normalization denominator and fitted slope/interval. Nonproportional exposure alone does not identify its mechanism.

concepts.name: Clearance measures
concepts.check: Separate systemic, apparent, unbound, renal, hepatic and intrinsic clearance. Bind each to its concentration basis, units and organ/system definition; do not cancel an unknown F.

concepts.name: Distribution volumes
concepts.check: Central, peripheral, steady-state, terminal-phase and apparent volumes differ. V1/V2 labels need the source compartment mapping; Vss alone is not Vc.

concepts.name: Intercompartmental exchange
concepts.check: Confirm the source meaning of Q; organ blood flow may use the same symbol. Exchange clearance and first-order transfer constants have different units.

concepts.name: Elimination and curve slopes
concepts.check: Distinguish model micro-rate constants from hybrid exponential slopes and the estimated terminal slope; compartment assumptions govern any equality.

concepts.name: Half-life
concepts.check: Retain the phase and estimation window. After extravascular dosing, a terminal slope can reflect absorption rather than elimination.

concepts.name: Urinary recovery
concepts.check: Keep collection window and dose denominator; link renal clearance to the matching plasma exposure interval.

concepts.name: Concentration basis
concepts.check: Bound and unbound fractions differ; do not apply an unbound conversion twice or treat nonspecific assay adsorption as protein binding. For fAUC/fCmax, retain the source's free-exposure definition and window.

concepts.name: Binding measurement
concepts.check: Retain matrix, species, method, concentration range and measured versus assumed status; animal binding does not establish human binding.

concepts.name: Site-specific exposure
concepts.check: Keep ratio numerator/denominator, free/total basis and concentration versus AUC basis. Plasma, serum, blood, ELF and homogenate are distinct; retain sampling/dilution corrections.

concepts.name: Noncompartmental analysis
concepts.check: NCA is an analysis approach, not a compartment count; keep the integration and terminal extrapolation methods.

concepts.name: Compartment structure
concepts.check: Keep input, elimination and parameterization with compartment count; a curved plot alone does not choose a structure.

concepts.name: Kinetic assumptions
concepts.check: Separate rate law from compartment count. A saturable model is not evidence that saturation occurred; preserve which process is nonlinear.

concepts.name: Fitting level
concepts.check: Do not equate pooled/mean fits with individual mixed-effects fits or reconstruct animal identities from summary curves.

concepts.name: Variability components
concepts.check: Variability and parameter-estimation uncertainty differ; retain covariance/correlation and the experimental unit. Do not invent IIV from mean data.

concepts.name: Observation model
concepts.check: Keep response scale, error assumptions and BLQ handling. A censoring method name does not supply a missing quantification limit.

concepts.name: Estimation algorithms
concepts.check: FOCEI and SAEM are estimation algorithms, not compartment models. Retain objective, approximation, priors and convergence information where stated.

concepts.name: Execution software
concepts.check: Software/version is distinct from the model and algorithm; naming a tool neither selects a method nor proves it was run.

concepts.name: Fit and comparison criteria
concepts.check: Retain observation set, likelihood/response scale, parameter count and comparison scope; a best score alone does not validate prediction.

concepts.name: Residual diagnostics
concepts.check: Keep residual definition and conditioning; an image path or scalar summary is not evidence that a residual plot was visually reviewed.

concepts.name: Simulation-based checks
concepts.check: Use the named diagnostic only with its data/design and predictive distribution; mixed-effects diagnostics are not blanket obligations for every PK model.

concepts.name: Uncertainty summaries
concepts.check: Retain interval level, target and resampling unit; parameter uncertainty, future observations and assumed population variability differ.

concepts.name: Estimation reliability
concepts.check: Optimizer success is not identifiability. Distinguish parameter-estimate correlation from random-effects correlation; preserve failed or unavailable checks.

concepts.name: Interspecies scaling
concepts.check: Retain predicted parameter, weight basis, species set and estimated versus fixed exponent; no exponent or binding correction is universally supplied by this glossary.

concepts.name: In vitro to in vivo extrapolation
terms: in vitro to in vivo extrapolation

aliases.IVIVE: in vitro to in vivo extrapolation

concepts.check: Preserve system, units, physiological scaling factors and equations. Incubation, plasma and blood binding are not interchangeable.

concepts.name: Human concentration-time prediction
concepts.check: Keep compatible parameter sets, compartment structure and dosing input. CL and Vss do not uniquely identify an arbitrary multicompartment curve.

concepts.name: Prediction evaluation
concepts.check: Retain validation target and error definition. Animal holdout performance is not target-drug human validation; no human data means human outputs remain prospective.

concepts.name: Susceptibility measurement
concepts.check: Retain isolate, method and conditions. A population MIC90 is not a matched isolate MIC; MIC is not EC50.

concepts.name: Exposure indices
concepts.check: Retain free exposure, MIC pairing and exposure window. Explicitly distinguish duration, fraction and percentage for time above MIC; an index is not its effect target.

concepts.name: Exposure-response models
concepts.check: Keep response definition, sign, units and source parameterization; maximum effect, half-maximal exposure and slope are separate parameters.

concepts.name: Effect target
concepts.check: Retain baseline/comparator and endpoint time; growth inhibition, bacterial killing and resistance suppression are different objectives.

concepts.name: Target attainment
concepts.check: Bind target, regimen, MIC and population assumptions. MIC-specific attainment and MIC-weighted summaries differ; PTA is not cure probability and assumed human IIV remains a scenario.

pk_binding_knowledge.supporting_metadata: Bind to drug/analyte, study/analysis, species and subject/group; retain other descriptors only when consequential. Never infer a match from species alone.
data_qualifiers: Preserve units, time origin/window, raw versus digitized and individual versus summary data, sampling unit and n; mean/median and SD/SEM/CV are distinct. Do not infer serial identity from destructive sampling.
Keep BLQ/BQL, LLOQ/ULOQ, LOD, missing and zero distinct; preserve assay limits and missingness reasons. Never invent a limit or treatment policy.
pk_binding_knowledge.shared_guidance: Use scientific_extraction.json for role/evidence status and CC005 for all 13 preservation categories, including negation, conditions and exceptions; these are not duplicated as PK keyword lists.
